title: CON THE ARTIST's Latest Single "ALL IN" Celebrates Commitment to Love
htmlContent:
South African musician and multi-talented artist CON THE ARTIST has just released his latest single, "ALL IN." The ballad captures the moment of discovering the perfect match emotionally, spiritually, and sexually, and committing to being with only that person, disregarding other prospects.

With a successful career in film composition and hip-hop production, CON has already made a name for himself, with his music being featured in shows and films on major networks such as Netflix, HBO, and MTV. Having toured as a musician with his band, CON has now gone solo to tell his stories through his guitar and production skills.

"ALL IN" is just the beginning of what promises to be an exciting year for CON THE ARTIST. In 2023, CON was accepted into the highly coveted CFC Music Residency and Screen Composer Academy. By year-end, he will work with a 34-piece orchestra while releasing a handful of singles and three EPs.
